- Later in that conversation you said the new one had **"been working great so far."**
- None of the items mention when the new remote shutter release was delivered. The other items (the sales follow-up emails and the sales-call transcript) have nothing to do with it.

**Step 2: Reasoning**

To count the days between ordering and receiving, I'd need both dates. I only have the order date (February 5th). Since it was working by the time of our conversation, it arrived sometime between February 5th and then, but no delivery date was ever given.

**Answer:** I can't tell how many days it took. You mentioned ordering it on February 5th and that it's been working well, but never said when it arrived. If you tell me the delivery date, I can work out the number of days.
